title: Landscaping Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Residential Landscaping Estimate: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Landscaping Estimate Worksheet covers lawn, bed, tree, shrub, hardscape edge, irrigation zone, and requested improvement. The landscape estimate coordinator records Residential Landscaping Estimate observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Landscaping Estimate Worksheet keeps Residential Landscaping Estimate exceptions visible until the landscape estimate coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Landscaping Estimate Worksheet at residential property, yard zone, access route, slope, and property edge. Document lawn, bed, tree, shrub, hardscape edge, irrigation zone, and requested improvement identity before Residential Landscaping Estimate begins. Compare lawn, bed, tree, shrub, hardscape edge, irrigation zone, and requested improvement findings with stated Residential Landscaping Estimate criteria; route unresolved Residential Landscaping Estimate issues to landscape operations reviewer.

items: Property boundary or utility location uncertain

blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Landscaping Estimate when a boundary, utility, access, tree, slope, chemical, or drainage concern remains. Retain the available Residential Landscaping Estimate proof and route unresolved lawn, bed, tree, shrub, hardscape edge, irrigation zone, and requested improvement scope to landscape estimate coordinator.
